answer.title: Automate Purchase Order Approval and Creation
answer.trigger: An employee emails a purchase order request for supplies or equipment.
steps: Receive the initial purchase order request email from staff.
Extract the item details and amount using AI to check if manager approval is required.
Forward the request details to the manager for review.
Wait for the manager to reply with approval confirmation.
Create the purchase order in the accounts system once approved.
answer.ai_help: Extracts the item, reference, and amount from the initial request email to route it correctly.
answer.human_approval: Sarah or another manager must approve the purchase order before it is created in the accounts system.
answer.risk_reason: Mistakes could result in unauthorized or incorrect purchases being made in the accounts system.
